sunita (infra): interesting that page reads ~ writes ~4k — suggests active paging, not just lazy eviction. Are onprem nodes using 4k vs hosted 2M hugepages? Any MTU/network differences for NFS-backed swap? :thinking:

lucas (oncall): +1 check for swapiness and cgroup settings. Dedicated nodes have cgroup.memory.swapiness=10 vs hosted 60? also check oom_kill_within_container false.
